certDuration.description: Go duration accepted by cert-manager, e.g. 720h0m0s.

databaseMode.description: external: existing PostgreSQL cluster. standalone: chart-managed Postgres. memory: in-memory only (dev/testing, data lost on restart).

tag.description: RMS API server image tag. Independent of Chart.yaml version.

enabled.description: Issue cert-manager Certificates for the API server and switch mTLS material. Requires cert-manager CRDs and a reachable issuer.

trustDomain.description: SPIFFE trust domain; empty omits the URI SAN.

uri.description: Full SPIFFE URI SAN, overriding trustDomain and path.

labels.description: Extra labels applied to every Certificate. Rendered into metadata.labels, so values must be strings.

annotations.description: Extra annotations applied to every Certificate. Rendered into metadata.annotations, so values must be strings.

nvssvt.description: NVSSVT scan launcher, colocated with the API server so RMS reaches it on loopback.

enabled.description: Run the NVSSVT launcher as a sidecar in the API server pod. When false, every node in a StartSystemValidation request fails to launch because nothing is listening on 127.0.0.1:8000.

pullPolicy.description: Defaults to IfNotPresent; the NVSSVT image is versioned independently of RMS.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Pod termination grace covering the 300-second RMS job drain, trace flush, and margin.

podAnnotations.description: Extra RMS Pod annotations. checksum/config is reserved by the chart.

strategy.description: Deployment rollout strategy (spec.strategy). Omit or null for the Kubernetes default RollingUpdate. Set type Recreate to pair with a ReadWriteOncePod firmware claim; set rollingUpdate.maxSurge 0 to avoid Multi-Attach stalls with ReadWriteOnce claims. rollingUpdate is rejected with type Recreate (Kubernetes refuses the combination).

type.description: Deployment strategy type. Recreate deletes the old pod before creating its replacement, which a ReadWriteOncePod claim requires: its volume cannot be mounted while the previous pod holds it.

rollingUpdate.description: Rolling-update tuning. maxSurge and maxUnavailable cannot both be 0; Kubernetes rejects a Deployment whose strategy can neither surge nor make pods unavailable.

maxUnavailable.description: Pods that may be unavailable during a rolling update (integer, or percentage string such as "25%").

maxSurge.description: Pods that may be created above the desired count during a rolling update (integer, or percentage string). 0 replaces pods instead of surging, avoiding Multi-Attach stalls with ReadWriteOnce claims and pairing with ReadWriteOncePod.

firmwarePersistentVolumeClaim.description: Existing PVC claimName for the firmware download filesystem. Empty string uses apiServer.firmwareStoragePath hostPath. Non-empty values must be valid Kubernetes DNS subdomain names.

firmwarePvc.description: Chart-owned firmware PVC configuration. null is treated as create=false: the firmware filesystem falls back to apiServer.firmwarePersistentVolumeClaim or the apiServer.firmwareStoragePath hostPath.

create.description: When true, the chart creates the firmware PersistentVolumeClaim (named apiServer.firmwarePersistentVolumeClaim, or "<fullname>-firmware" when unset) instead of requiring a pre-created PVC or hostPath. The Deployment then mounts the created claim. null is treated as false (unset).

keep.description: When true (default), the created firmware PVC carries helm.sh/resource-policy: keep so it and its firmware artifacts survive helm uninstall. null is treated as unset (true); only an explicit false lets uninstall delete the claim. A kept claim outlives the release: a same-name reinstall fails with an already-exists error until the claim is deleted or adopted with --take-ownership. Ignored when create is false.

size.description: Requested storage size for the created firmware PVC, as a Kubernetes quantity (e.g. 20Gi). null falls back to the default. Ignored when create is false.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the created firmware PVC. Empty string uses the cluster default; "-" disables dynamic provisioning. Ignored when create is false.

accessModes.description: Access modes for the created firmware PVC. ReadWriteOncePod must be the only entry in the list (Kubernetes rejects combining it with another mode), allows only one pod to mount the claim (apiServer.replicaCount 1), and requires a delete-before-create rollout: strategy.type Recreate or strategy.rollingUpdate.maxSurge 0. Ignored when create is false.

nmxGatewayId.description: gateway_id sent on NMX-C gRPC requests from RMS (config.toml [switches] nmx_gateway_id).

dbPoolMax.description: Maximum size of the Postgres connection pool (config.toml [postgres] db_pool_max). Must be greater than 0.

maxTrackedJobs.description: Maximum number of async job records the tracker retains (config.toml [workflows] max_tracked_jobs). Must be greater than 0.

terminalJobTtlSeconds.description: Retention period for completed and failed job records, in seconds (config.toml [workflows] terminal_job_ttl_seconds). Must be greater than 0.

firmwareTaskTimeoutSeconds.description: Upper bound in seconds on polling one firmware task for completion (config.toml [workflows] firmware_task_timeout_seconds). Must be greater than 0.

firmwareTaskPollIntervalSeconds.description: Delay in seconds between polls of an in-flight firmware task (config.toml [workflows] firmware_task_poll_interval_seconds). Must be greater than 0 and <= firmwareTaskTimeoutSeconds.

firmwareTaskTransientErrorTimeoutSeconds.description: How long in seconds to tolerate consecutive firmware task-status read failures before failing the update (config.toml [workflows] firmware_task_transient_error_timeout_seconds). Must be greater than 0.

computePowerOnTimeoutSeconds.description: How long in seconds a compute firmware update waits for the tray to report power On after the power-on that opens the flow (config.toml [workflows] compute_power_on_timeout_seconds). Must be greater than 0. The power-on step that reads it arrives in a following change. Until then RMS validates and stores the value and nothing reads it.

computePowerOnPollIntervalSeconds.description: Delay in seconds between power-state reads during that wait (config.toml [workflows] compute_power_on_poll_interval_seconds). Must be greater than 0 and <= computePowerOnTimeoutSeconds. The power-on step that reads it arrives in a following change. Until then RMS validates and stores the value and nothing reads it.

artifactRequireSha256.description: When true, HTTP(S) firmware artifacts must include a SHA-256 digest (config.toml [workflows] artifact_require_sha256).

artifactHttpsHosts.description: HTTP(S) firmware artifact host allow-list (config.toml [workflows] artifact_https_hosts). Empty allows any host. Pattern and RPC scope: docs/configuration/configuring-rms.md#artifact-download-policy.

artifactAllowPrivateTargets.description: When false, reject loopback/private/link-local HTTP(S) artifact targets including redirects (config.toml [workflows] artifact_allow_private_targets).

expectedInventoryProfiles.description: Opaque expected-inventory profile identifiers mapped to NVFWUPD AP names and optional physical Flint device counts (config.toml [workflows.expected_inventory_profiles]).

logLevel.description: Optional log level / filter directive replacing RUST_LOG (config.toml [logging] log_level). Empty string uses the default info level plus dependency caps.

enableTimestamps.description: Assuming a logging collector is adding its own timestamps, so this is disabled by default to prevent duplicate timestamp fields. If no logging collector is being used, set true to output timestamps natively (config.toml [logging] enable_timestamps).

certReloadIntervalSeconds.description: How often RMS re-reads the gRPC server certificate and key, in seconds (config.toml [tls] cert_reload_interval_seconds). Must be greater than 0. The client CA is not reloaded.

endpoint.description: Explicit OTLP Collector URL. Requires HTTPS with a certificate trusted by RMS unless the host is a loopback IP address (127.0.0.0/8 or ::1), which may use plaintext http. Empty disables remote export.

protocol.description: OTLP protocol over TLS: grpc or HTTP/protobuf over HTTPS.
